description: SHA-256 of the private language-ID held-out set (eval/langid/heldout/, not in git). Texts are never shown to the detector's author; only aggregate scores are published.
scoring: a label outside 'acceptable' is WRONG; 'unsure' (or any non-target code) is an abstention. non_target items: any sw/en/de/fr label is a critical error.

sources.name: FLORES-200 devtest (kik_Latn, kam_Latn, luo_Latn)
sources.selection: every 97th devtest line with 6-20 words; truncated items keep the first 5 words
sources.does_not_cover: informal, misspelled or code-switched Kikuyu/Kamba/Luo as typed on phones

sources.name: Sheng lines and 2-3 word reviews
sources.does_not_cover: real tourist SMS; Sheng written by non-speakers, unreviewed
